cds.title: Slippery Rock University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

navigator.title: IPEDS / College Navigator - Slippery Rock University of Pennsylvania

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set: international first-year applicants 228, admitted 81 (36%), enrolled 6, far below the 74% overall admit rate, so SRU is not an automatic admit for international applicants; the Common Data Set does not say why (for example incomplete applications). The waitlist section says there is no waitlist policy, while SRU's admissions page describes a waitlist for applicants below the guidelines. 12% (178 students) of enrolled first-years submitted SAT; the Common Data Set prints ACT as 0% with 30 students, so the share of students who sent ACT scores is not shown. SAT/ACT percentiles are for those submitters only (ACT: 30 students). The admission factors section marks test scores 'important' although applications are test-optional. The GPA breakdown is the all-enrolled column (3.58 average). Undergraduate enrollment 7,088 and 248 nonresident undergraduates are from the Common Data Set (fall 2025).

cds_test_policy.notes: Test policy from the Common Data Set (Fall 2027): SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set: 62 undergraduate degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid, average $1,775 (total $110,038); the Common Data Set text does not show whether it was need- or non-need-based. For 2026-27 the Common Data Set lists tuition $7,994 in-state and $11,992 out-of-state/nonresident, required fees $3,470, food and housing $11,098; the cost figures come from the international cost matrix
